response.sql: SELECT sc.zoneref, s.phasefactor, AVG(sc.scancount) as avg_scancount, AVG(sc.pressratio) as avg_pressratio FROM scans sc INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sc.scancount > 11 GROUP BY sc.zoneref, s.phasefactor ORDER BY AVG(sc.pressratio) DESC NULLS LAST, s.phasefactor NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
